our_interpretation: The antecedent requires serious actual harm causally linked to premature or rushed military AI deployment, not merely AI use during a harmful operation.
Really bad ordinarily includes substantial loss of life or a comparably grave military incident. Whether a narrowly avoided disaster qualifies is ambiguous.
Own it is read as Trump being held publicly or politically responsible, rather than necessarily accepting blame or incurring legal liability.
No deadline is supplied for either the harmful event or the attribution of responsibility.
criteria.support_condition: After the antecedent is established, authoritative findings or broad public attribution hold Trump responsible for the resulting harm.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, a sufficiently complete accountability record clearly rejects responsibility attributable to Trump. Lack of immediate blame alone is insufficient.
